blocks.text: ORI is a new-generation Proof-of-Work (PoW) value-storage asset designed to solve the inherent "value leakage" problem in the Bitcoin model. Through an innovative on-chain reverse-inflow mechanism, ORI redirects miner costs back into the system, achieving a fully closed, self-sustaining loop of on-chain value circulation.
The token starts mining from 0 with no premine, no VC, and no team allocation. Everything is decentralized and de-organizationalized. ORI is the on-chain native <0>BTC 2.0</0>.
Mining Mechanism
Each round lasts 1 minute. The system randomly selects 1 winning cell from a <0>5×5 grid</0>:
Users deposit <0>BNB</0> into any cells (single, multiple, or all);
Users may choose <0>Manual Mode</0> (one round) or <1>Auto Mode</1> (multiple rounds, BNB collected upfront);
The platform charges <0>1%</0> of the mining amount as a platform fee.
Draw & Distribution
A draw occurs automatically every minute, determined by an <0>on-chain random number</0>;
If no one participates or no one stakes the winning cell, the round is <0>void</0> with no distribution.
Outcomes
Not Winning
All deposited <0>BNB</0> is lost.
Normal Win
Receives <0>90%</0> of all BNB in the round's prize pool, distributed proportionally to the winning cell's deposits;
Simultaneously generates <0>1 ORI reward</0>, with:
<0>50% probability</0>: awarded to one random winner;
<0>50% probability</0>: distributed proportionally to all winners.
Motherlode Jackpot
Additional <0>+0.2 ORI</0> is minted into the Motherlode Pool each round;
Trigger probability is <0>1/625</0>;
If not triggered, it accumulates until the trigger occurs and is then fully distributed;
Distribution rules follow the same logic as a normal round.
ORI holders can stake tokens to earn protocol revenue shares:
<0>6%</0> of BNB from every mining round (after deducting the platform's 1% fee) is used for protocol-level ORI buybacks;
Bought-back ORI is allocated:
<0>5/6</0> → ORI Pool for future redistribution;
<0>1/6</0> → Staking Pool for stakers;
Stakers earn real-time rewards based on their share of the staked ORI supply;
No fees are charged upon unstaking.
This mechanism gives stakers a dual benefit — <0>token appreciation from buybacks</0> + <1>staking rewards</1>.
Basic Information
Max supply: <0>4,200,000 ORI</0>
Issuance: Fair mining, no team or reserved allocation
Mint rate: <0>1 + 0.2 ORI</0> per minute
Void-round protection: No issuance if no participation or no stake in the winning cell
Buyback & Redistribution
<0>10%</0> of BNB from each mining round is automatically used by the protocol to buy back ORI and the 起源 Token;
Buyback slippage is set at <0>60%</0>;
The purchased tokens are distributed proportionally as follows:
<0>50%</0> → Bury Pool (ORI Pool)
<0>10%</0> → Staking Pool
<0>40%</0> → Bury Pool (起源 Pool)
Refinement & Fees
Mining reward claims incur a <0>10%</0> refinement fee;
Platform mining fee is <0>1%</0>, used for protocol maintenance;
All flows are executed on-chain, fully transparent and verifiable.
